note: Runtime access grants per service, provisioned by scripts/grant_service_access.sh and read by services at startup to reach a datastore/resource. persistence: a 'bounded' grant carries an expires_at and lapses at the stabilization-window close; a 'standing' grant has no expiry and persists until revoked. privileged=true marks a grant whose action is write/admin or whose resource is a wildcard/unnamed. See docs/runbooks/access_provisioning.md.
